pending_blockers: Canonical Host normal-home versus raw USERPROFILE comparison rejects valid forward-slash spelling in ensureLaunch and prelaunch intent validation

diagnostic_events.detail: Actual launch-input and inner scope specify USERPROFILE C:/Users/yqyyds. Runner passes this unchanged; Desktop passes USERPROFILE unchanged to Core. Host obtains OS-account HomeDir then filepath.Clean. B1 constructor compares Clean on both sides and accepts the same location. B3 ensureLaunch compares raw strings with EqualFold and therefore rejects slash versus backslash before root PrivateDirectory or receipt creation. The capture intent validator repeats the same defective comparison. This is a sufficient deterministic rejection in the bound source; public Task evidence does not expose which individual disjunct ran first.

actual_observations.task_message: Native preparation failed before model launch; no automatic replay

evidence_chain: Actual launch-input explicit_environment.USERPROFILE and scope.windows.normal_user_profile both equal C:/Users/yqyyds. Runner makeEnvironment:72-85 preserves the raw spelling and _electron.launch:485-486 uses that same env object.

Pinned Desktop desktop-management.js managedControlEnvironment:793-799 copies nonempty USERPROFILE verbatim; start:430-439 uses its returned env to spawn the managed Core. No intervening home normalization exists there.

Pinned Host harness_windows.go:201-217 obtains user.Current().HomeDir, calls codexNormalHome, then passes that home to the native-qualified RPC constructor. codexNormalHome:224-228 returns filepath.Clean(home). No EvalSymlinks is used by this Host helper; that part of the initial hypothesis is unnecessary.

Pinned NewCodexRPC:52-57 already checks EqualFold(filepath.Clean(NormalHome), filepath.Clean(USERPROFILE)). It preserves NormalHome and does not rewrite USERPROFILE. Successful private driver construction does not imply the later raw-string predicate will match.

Pinned B3 ensureLaunch:569-578 creates only in-memory observation/context, then evaluates raw NormalHome versus USERPROFILE at line571. False equality returns QUALIFICATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH before exactReal(root/source/helper), PrivateDirectory(root), os.Mkdir(receipts), collector or Native launch.

Pinned capture_windows.go:246-247 repeats raw EqualFold(context.NormalHome, USERPROFILE), so fixing only ensureLaunch would leave a later prelaunch intent rejection. Both sites need the same comparison semantics.

Actual final Task is a known preparation failure and events contain no ASSISTANT. The exact receipt path is derived from SHA256(run_id + / + epoch), checked directly after original Job stop, and its parent does not exist. This supports the early failure stage; absence alone cannot identify a unique failed guard.

pure_counterexamples: Canonical backslash Host home versus forward-slash USERPROFILE for the identical drive/path accepts.
Same path with case variation and ordinary separator normalization accepts under Windows semantics; identity remains the same canonical absolute directory.
Different user or different drive/root rejects; prefix sibling such as user versus user2 rejects.
Empty USERPROFILE, empty trusted home, relative/drive-relative path, embedded NUL/CR/LF/semicolon reject.
Both production call sites use the same predicate; final immutable intent context/EnvironmentHash tampering still rejects independently.
